Messages.Author: wesile
Messages.Body:
Apep is the demon of the Egyptians...

Servitor of Apep
Master - Trifle
1

Put this card on Fos in your uncontrolled region who is not infernal.
While this FoS vampire is controlled, he or she is Infernal and has . This card remains in play, even the vampire is in the uncontrolled region. A minion can only have one Servitor of Apep.

You can pay one additional pool to give this vampire one level of  or  .

Image: a servant bowing to a large snake in a temple.

Messages.Author: Boris The Blade
Messages.Body:
This line is redundant and just the application of the rules:

Servitor of Apep
Master - Trifle
1

Put this card on Fos in your uncontrolled region who is not infernal.
While this FoS vampire is controlled, he or she is Infernal and has . This card remains in play, even the vampire is in the uncontrolled region. A minion can only have one Servitor of Apep.

You can pay one additional pool to give this vampire one level of  or  .

I don't like the Uncontrolled requirement: it means you cannot get your vampires out before drawing the card. Better play it on a controlled vampire as usual. When can you pay a pool to gain  or ?

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body: Can't have a burn option if you have no requirements.

Messages.Author: Boris The Blade
Messages.Body:
Cadet is a bad card, precisely for this flow reason. Don't try to copy it. It can kind of work for Black Hand because most good Black Hand do not actually require a Black Hand vampire to play them but a Seraph to play it to benefit other Black Hand vampires, so if you fail to make your vampires Black Hand, you lose some benefits but card flow is not hurt.

It's not the same in your case: if your vampire fails to become infernal, your  cards will jam your hand.

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
> wesile wrote:
> FoS and Baali both deal with corruption...
>
Well, yes, but :
* it's different corruption (in short, FoS want you to be dissolved, i.e. morally corrupt, while Baali are about spiritual corruption and especially helping them destroy the world)
* FoS and Baali tend to dislike each other, partly because FoS are (supposed) corrupter and not corrupted, and partly because Set is not a demon and don't want to share his tool, and the same for demons

Now, Follower of set are completely suspectible to infernal corruption. As are Tremere.

I approve.
